detail.title: Journal Entry: Mechanisms of Autocatalytic Memory and Chemical Heredity
detail.summary: Continued systematic investigation into non-linear reaction network memory and the transition from persistence to heritable information storage. Research actions are prioritized for experimental evidence of hysteresis in autocatalytic networks.

children.title: experimental evidence of hysteresis in non-linear chemical reaction networks

detail.reason: Bridging theoretical potential for memory in autocatalytic networks with observable experimental hysteresis.

children.title: distinguish kinetic relaxation vs functional chemical memory in autocatalytic reaction networks

detail.reason: Clarifying the distinction between slow kinetic relaxation and true state-retention mechanisms.
